sources.entry: JupyterLab - Web-based environment for interactive and reproducible computing. (Demo, Source Code) BSD-3-Clause Python/Docker

summary.one_liner: JupyterLab is an extensible, browser-based interface for interactive and reproducible computing that bundles notebooks, a terminal, a text editor, a file browser, and rich output rendering.
summary.what_it_does: JupyterLab is the next-generation user interface for Project Jupyter, offering the building blocks of the classic Jupyter Notebook (notebook, terminal, text editor, file browser, rich outputs) in a more flexible layout. It can be installed with conda, mamba, or pip and launched with the "jupyter lab" command, which opens it in a web browser. It can be extended with npm packages that use its public APIs, and prebuilt extensions can be distributed through PyPI, conda, and other package managers. Source extensions can be installed from npm but require an extra build step. The README also points to GitHub topic jupyterlab-extension for finding more extensions.
use_cases: interactive data analysis in the browser
editing text files and browsing project files in one interface
building custom extensions for a notebook-style IDE
notable: Modular, extensible architecture where extensions are built on public npm-based APIs
Combines notebook, terminal, text editor, and file browser in one interface
Installable via pip, conda, or mamba
Part of Project Jupyter, governed by the Jupyter Frontends Council under BSD-style shared copyright
caveats: JupyterLab 3 reached end of maintenance on May 15, 2024; users are urged to upgrade to JupyterLab 4
Source extensions need an additional build step
Known to work only in the latest Firefox, Chrome, and Safari, per the README
